items.where: Text Summary of the Protocol, P1
items.my_version: This protocol is meant to be done in phases. Don't skip any, since you only move on to the next phase if the one you're on doesn't clear up your symptoms.
items.before: This protocol is designed to be executed in phases. Do not skip phases. You only move to the next phase if the current one fails to resolve symptoms.

items.title: Phase 2 in your voice
items.where: the heading "Phase 2: The Reset (The Architect & Scientist)"
items.my_version:
#### Phase 2: The Reset

This is Dr. Michael Ruscio (Healthy Gut, Healthy You) and Dr. Mark Pimentel (The Microbiome Connection): calm the inflammation down and starve the overgrowths, no harsh chemicals.

Diet-wise, go Paleo-Low FODMAP (Ruscio) or Low Fermentation Eating (Pimentel). Either way you stop feeding the bacteria in your small intestine.

And no snacking! Pimentel wants meals 4-5 hours apart, strictly, so the Migrating Motor Complex (MMC) gets to sweep your gut clean in between.

My notes: see Poor diet now and Plant foods, above.

items.title: Phase 3 in your voice
items.my_version:
#### Phase 3: The Purge

If diet didn't clear your symptoms, you likely have an active overgrowth (SIBO/SIFO). This one is from Dr. William Davis (Super Gut) and Dr. Michael Ruscio.

AVOID most herbal antibiotics, even though Davis recommends specific herbal combinations like Candibactin AR/BR or FC Cidal/Dysbiocide for 4 weeks.

H2O2 actually works better than the herbal antibiotics according to me and orthomolecular drs. My BFF Pooyan tried candibactin actually and it nearly killed him. The H2O2 worked a lot better without side effects. There is one herbal antibiotic that works really well tho for H. pylori: Berberine. If you have an acute infection with something that those don't help quickly, consider escalating to secnidazole treatment for rapid cure, and paromomycin post-treatment for relapse prevention, with medical supervision.

BIND to the toxins, especially the metals and parasite die-off toxins, using Zholy3O.

At the same time, take Ruscio's Triple Probiotic Support, a blend of Lacto/Bifido, S. boulardii, and Soil-Based organisms. That's to maintain diversity and prevent opportunistic infections (like C. diff) during the kill phase.

And if the herbs failed, the overgrowth is too severe or the gut lining is too damaged for solids, so it's time for Ruscio's "Nuclear" Option, the Elemental Diet. That's a 2-3 week liquid-only diet (predigested nutrients), which starves the bacteria completely while still nourishing you.

My notes: the H2O2 swap above is mine, not the books'. For berberine and H. pylori see Parasites, and for SIBO yogurt see SIBO, above.

items.title: Phase 4 in your voice
items.my_version:
#### Phase 4: The Investigation

Benjamin Brown (Digestive Health Solution) is the only source for this phase. If even the "Nuclear Option" failed, you can cross the microbiome off the list. The problem is likely organ failure, or environmental toxicity or brain plasticity (those two are Phase 6, below).

So check your organs (Brown). Is it Exocrine Pancreatic Insufficiency? You'd test for that with Stool Elastase, and treat it with high-dose enzymes. Or is it Bile Acid Diarrhea? That test is SeHCAT, and the treatment is bile binders.

My notes: two things the books don't cover, old impaction and colon hydrotherapy (Years of accumulated shit, above) and psychedelics for IBS (IBS, above).

items.title: Phase 5 in your voice
items.your_version:
Phase 5: Restoration & Maintenance (Let's Play Gardener!)
Once you're clear of infection, you have to rebuild a diverse ecosystem to prevent relapse. Dr. William Davis is back for that, along with Dr. Will Bulsiewicz (Fiber Fueled).
Start by re-seeding with Davis's high-dose "SIBO Yogurt", fermented for 36 hours. It contains L. reuteri, to heal the lining and boost oxytocin, and L. gasseri, to produce bacteriocins that kill SIBO.
Then feed the new healthy bacteria. Bulsiewicz says to slowly titrate plant diversity back into your diet, aiming for 30+ different plants per week. Does anyone count their plants?
Continue Pimentel's strict meal spacing from Phase 2 (4+ hours), forever, to keep the MMC cleaning wave active.
And fuel the mitochondria: see the fuels under Leaky gut, above (glutamine, butyrate and TCA intermediates).
My notes: see Leaky gut above for colostrum, zinc carnosine, BPC-157, ozonated zeolite and the fuels, and Sitting above for movement and yoga.

items.title: Phase 6 in your voice
items.where: the heading "Phase 6: Refractory Cases (The Hazmat Team)"
items.my_version:
#### Phase 6: Refractory Cases

The last phase is from Neil Nathan (Toxic) and Annie Hopper (Wired for Healing). It's for people who are "sensitive to everything," or who relapse right away even though they've stuck to the protocol perfectly.

Check your environment (Nathan). Could it be mold/mycotoxins, or Lyme? Get assessed for those, and if it comes back positive, use specific binders (Cholestyramine, Charcoal, Clay).

Then check the brain. If you react to everything, Hopper says the issue is Limbic System Impairment, and you'd use "Brain Retraining" (DNRS) to stop the brain from firing false "danger" signals to the gut.

My notes: Matt's note on mopping up mycotoxins with fermented colostrum is under Leaky gut, above.

items.your_version:
Phase 1: The Pre-Flight Safety Check
Before you throw supplements or antimicrobials at your gut, the system mechanics that are foundational to gut function have to work. This part is from T.C. Hale (Kick Your Fat in the Nuts) and Stanley Rosenberg (Accessing the Healing Power of the Vagus Nerve).
Are your pupils dilated all the time? Are you missing your gag reflex? Then according to Hale, you're stuck in fight or flight mode (which in medical lingo is called "sympathetic dominance"), and digestion is offline. Rosenberg's fix is his Basic Exercise (eye movements) or the Salamander technique (which looks like some kind of yoga, see a video demo here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OZdvU0c6cCg). Both of those help to mechanically release the vagus nerve so your body can switch into rest and digest mode.
Now let's have a look at your bile function. Do you burp extra (not just like one little burp) after fatty meals? Do your stools float (like it's hard to flush), or look like clay? Then your bile is stagnant (not flowing well), and Hale says if you take antimicrobials now, you'll get a herx reaction you can't detoxify. So thin the bile first with Beet Flow (an extract of beet greens) or phosphatidylcholine, before starting on any pathogen killing protocol.
My notes: for stress and sleep see Severe stress above, and for stomach acid and bile see Low stomach acid.
